patterns: APPSC G1 asks interpretive one-liners on party-system change (BJP's rise, first coalition govt, UPA partners, AP Congress' lowest seat tally 1994).
Scholar -> term is a recurring trap: Rajni Kothari credited with 'one-party dominant system / Congress system' in PSC keys.
Election milestones: 1967 (State coalitions, SVD; Bihar most), 1977 first non-Congress govt, 1989 end of Congress system with INC still largest party.
Assertion-reason items on Indian party system are common in UP PSCs; app uses more statement/match items with Lok Sabha seat data and 2026 current context.
